description:
Brand Introduction:

Yakhani.com is your all-in-one platform for the built environment. From connecting professionals like architects, engineers, and contractors to offering a curated marketplace for building materials, we’re transforming how people plan, build, and buy in Southern Africa. Whether it’s a homeowner searching for tiling solutions or a developer looking for local talent, Yakhani.com brings everything under one roof.

Product Description:

We offer two core services:

  1. Professional Directory – A trusted network of built environment professionals, allowing users to find, compare, and contact experts easily.

  2. Online Store – A growing ecommerce platform focused on building products like tiles, fittings, tools, and finishes – all handpicked from reliable vendors.

Our hybrid model supports both discovery and direct purchase, making construction projects easier and faster to manage.

USP (Unique Selling Point):

Yakhani.com is more than just a directory or an online store – it’s a digital ecosystem for the construction and design industry.
Key differentiators include:

  • Africa-focused platform tailored to the needs of local builders and homeowners

  • Dual offering: Service provider search + material purchasing

  • Carefully vetted vendors and professionals

  • Dedicated support for buyers and sellers

  • Marketing boost for listed professionals and affiliates

Payment Terms:

Affiliates earn a competitive commission for every qualifying sale or lead generated through their unique referral link.

  • Payouts: Every 60 days via EFT or Paypal

  • Minimum payout threshold: R2000

  • Commission structure: Tiered, depending on product category or service referral

  • Tracking: 15-day cookie tracking for affiliate links

Other Information:

  • Who can join? Bloggers, influencers, content creators, industry professionals, or anyone with an audience in construction, real estate, or home improvement.

  • Marketing Support: Access to ready-made graphics, promotional copy, and periodic campaigns

  • Dashboard Access: Track your clicks, conversions, and payouts in real-time

  • No hidden fees: Joining is free and there are no ongoing charges to stay in the programme

  • Dedicated Affiliate Support: Our team is on hand to help you
